title: Magazine p. 48: Gemini-12 hatch debris and blowups of Gemini-11 photos of Proton-3
description: Photocopied magazine page with several numbered photographs and article text. Photo 16 is captioned "Debris from open hatch on Gemini-12," photo 15 "Fragment in focus at range of 3 to 5 feet" with a handwritten note "enlargement of 16," and photos 17 and 18 show irregular blobs captioned "Blowups of Gemini-11 photos of Proton-3. Sun glare and extreme magnification contribute to bizarre appearance." The text quotes astronaut Pete Conrad on claims that he was followed by a UFO on Apollo-12.
